title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：summary　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 summary 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the writer ① wrote the summary that no reader in the study would have counted, and he said the writing was the whole of the month. The ② summary, meaning the outline itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed uncounted in the book; a summary, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ summary in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ summary at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A summary, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the writer said the counting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the summary was the whole of the matter, meaning the point and not the outline. The ⑥ summary, meaning the point and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; summary, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both an outline and a point. He said the point is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ summary had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ summary of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of counting; summary, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ summary I remember is the outline counted in the manuscript, which closed in 2001 and is still counted as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ summary, my mother said in 2003, is the only outline that improves by being counted; every summary, she said, is a point that has agreed to look like an outline. She said the point was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 摘要；总结（指书斋里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 摘要；总结（指那份摘要本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：write the summary 写这一份摘要
D. n. 摘要；总结（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 摘要之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的摘要之事）
F. n. 摘要；总结（指手稿里写到、被清点的那一份）
G. n. 摘要、要义（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 要义（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: wrote the summary that no reader in the study would have counted
The summary, meaning the outline itself and not the page
the summary at the far shelf
the summary was the whole of the matter
the summary had become a line in a manuscript
The summary of the whole thing
A summary, my mother said in 2003

answers.why: write the summary 意为“写这一份摘要”，1994 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯清点的一份摘要做了一遍。
summary 意为“摘要；总结”，指那份摘要本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。
summary 意为“摘要；总结”，指书斋里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
summary 意为“摘要；总结”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
summary 意为“摘要、要义”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份要义就是那件事的全部。
summary 意为“要义”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份摘要，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
summary 意为“摘要；总结”，指手稿里写到、被清点的那一份，到 1999 年这一份成了手稿里的一行。
summary 意为“摘要之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的摘要之事是一处书斋和三个月份的清点。
summary 意为“摘要；总结”，我记得的是手稿里清点过的那一份，2001 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一份。
summary 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，摘要是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的摘要。
